title: Knaights
description:
Knaights is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world, with linear base-vs-base combat. You start with a castle and 3 knights and build a kingdom strong enough to take your opponent's stronghold. Each turn, choose orders for everything you own (structures, troops, and a perk for your team). Once both sides submit, every order plays out at once.

Knights (the main fellow/lady in the game) quest, attack, and guard. A knight sent on a quest risks its life out in the world, but one who makes it back brings spoils and earns a name on the field. Spend those spoils to grow your army: archers, wizards, cavalry, dogs, imps and more.

• 38 perks to build your team around, one pick each turn
• 23 spells, cast from your wizard towers
• 8 structures, from the Training Grounds to the Engineering Shack
• 220 skins across 15 troop and structure types, each with its own unlock condition
• 12 Steam achievements
Play singleplayer against the AI on four difficulties, take turns on one screen in Local Hotseat (it works over Steam Remote Play too), or go online in casual or competitive matches. Anything but a competitive match can be saved and resumed. Depending on your strategy and the difficulty, a match can last anywhere between 30 minutes and a week, with no time pressure on your turns unless you're playing competitively.

Wear your opponent down and get your troops to their castle. Once its health is gone, you reign victorious.

Fully playable with just a mouse. Keyboard and controller are supported too. A tutorial walks you through your first match. Available in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish (Spain and Latin America) and Vietnamese.
description_short: Turn-based medieval strategy where both sides move at once. Build your base, train an army, send knights on quests for spoils and a name, and bring down your opponent's castle first. Play against the AI, hotseat on one screen or over Remote Play, or online.
